requirement: Website Opportunities: two sub-tabs (Find places | My opportunities N) kept in the page address; My opportunities pages 50 rows newest first by cursor, polls only moving rows by id, merges rows added elsewhere on top, bulk Resume/Cancel by job ids or by the filter on screen, falls back to the old whole list; one next action per row run the same from the table, the Inspector and the Details page

oracle.invariant: 0 failures. The address keeps wo-view, wo-stage, wo-q, wo-opp, wo-page and wo-brief beside tab= and other parameters, drops values it cannot mean, and writes nothing for defaults. A page answer with counts/nextCursor is paged; one without is the old whole list, which the screen filters, searches and counts itself. The poll asks only for rows whose research waits or runs or whose demo site is still being built, at most 100 ids a call; polled rows keep their place; rows added elsewhere go on top. Bulk Resume takes paused, blocked, failed and cancelled jobs; bulk Cancel takes queued, running, paused and blocked ones; Select all matching sends the filter on screen. Cancel and Resume call the job doors, Start research sends a request id, Build demo submits one durable demo action (buildDemo) and a lost receipt replays the same request id, Retry demo names the failed action under a new request id, Send demo opens the send step, Open the site goes to the site in Tracy. The Details page reads the same Status and next action from the detail answer as the list row.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)
